owner: Canonical Powerhouse Security Operations and Supabase backend
root_cause: Deployed verify_jwt=false edge function invoked privileged Postgres maintenance operation without a bearer, secret-key or signed request check. A public request could run a service-authority command.
prevention_rule: Before any privileged DB URL read, connection or write, require POST and a verified server-only credential (legacy service_role Bearer or modern Supabase default secret apikey). Reject anon/publishable/user JWT and malformed/missing secrets; never reflect raw database errors. Record independent Supabase runtime and unauthenticated 401/405 readbacks; never accept a successful deployment alone as proof.

evidence.source: Supabase deployed function db-pooler-repair-v1 version 6, verify_jwt false; 789 bytes of source with no authentication guard
evidence.log_query: 0 function name matches in last 24h unified logs, not proof of absence

limitations: Other unauthenticated Edge Functions remain subject to separate authorization assessment.
Do not place service_role or secret keys into client code.
Do not claim complete attack protection or auto-run a privileged DB tick to prove successful authorized behavior.
